incidents.summary: British Land's four-week facial-recognition trial at Meadowhall involved police participation and prompted a regulator to call for government intervention.

sources.title: Meadowhall facial recognition scheme troubles watchdog - BBC News
sources.quote: Police involvement in a private landlord's facial recognition trial has led a regulator to call for government intervention.

sources.title: Meadowhall facial recognition scheme troubles watchdog - BBC News
sources.quote: Meadowhall owner British Land said the 2018 test only lasted four weeks.

sources.title: Meadowhall facial recognition scheme troubles watchdog - BBC News
sources.quote: It added that it had "no plans" to use facial recognition at its sites, and that all personal data gathered during the trial was "immediately deleted".

positives: British Land and Sir Robert McAlpine used Achilles' service to assess supply-chain labour practices through information from tradespeople working on their sites.
